review_of_assigned_points.soft_gumbel_default_0_5: upstream functions have no default; 0.5 is the argparse default of experiments/gms/soft.py and gumbel.py. review_of_assigned_points.log_weight_normalisation: justified: diffusion_resampling, systematic/stratified and ensemble_ot use exp(log_ws) as normalised weights; every upstream caller normalises with log_ws - logsumexp(log_ws) first. For the already-normalised executor inputs the renormalisation is bitwise a no-op (checked), so all native comparisons are bitwise; unnormalised inputs give the same result as upstream on the normalised weights, and input_log_normaliser is returned.
review_of_assigned_points.minus_inf_weights: accepted correctly: direct upstream calls with every third weight zero give finite outputs for all methods (multinomial, stratified, systematic, multinomial_stopped, ensemble_ot default and eps=0.3, soft alpha 0/0.5/1, gumbel, diffusion); soft with alpha<1 legitimately returns -inf output log weights for selected zero-weight particles, which the wrapper's NaN-only output check allows. review_of_assigned_points.jitter: an upstream parameter (diffusion_resampling(..., jitter=0.) line 198, added to the reference variances); used with 1e-5 by demos/gradient_variance2.py, demos/gradient_variance.py, experiments/lokta/diffusion.py and experiments/cifar10/run.py.
